answers.core:
It is about correcting the placement of the ticks because they are in some cases misaligned with the grabber, which makes them loose their purpose.
And to make the use of the ticks less painful for the user.
answers.workaround: The code cannot be worked around with a few lines of script, since you have to change the math behind the placement of the ticks and change the slider property, but this should not be too difficult to do. (I'm planning to code it)

title: Change the way ticks are drawn in a slider.
